upload.title: Upload Manuscript
upload.desc: The system securely receives your manuscript, extracts the text, graphs, and tables, and creates a smart digital workspace ready for scientific analysis.

data_vision.title: Data & Graphs Validation
data_vision.desc: We cross-check your raw data (e.g., from Excel) against the graphs and tables in your manuscript to ensure there are no statistical errors that could delay publication.

predict_pre.title: Acceptance Predictor
predict_pre.desc: The system compares your study against the standards of leading medical journals, providing an initial estimate of your manuscript's chances of acceptance.

clarification.title: Clarification & Ping-Pong
clarification.desc: The system will ask you focused questions about your research goals and key messages. This quick ping-pong ensures the editing aligns perfectly with your clinical perspective.

planning.title: Structural Planning
planning.desc: A specialized agent scans your manuscript and builds a detailed work plan. It identifies paragraphs that need strengthening and arguments that require more solid medical evidence.

knowledge.title: Literature Enrichment
knowledge.desc: The system connects in real-time to academic databases like PubMed to verify your citations and search for recent studies that can strengthen your clinical arguments.

sci_review.title: Simulated Peer Review
sci_review.desc: The system simulates a committee of rigorous scientific reviewers who critically read your paper. They identify potential weaknesses in your methodology, exactly as journal editors would.

area_chair.title: Editorial Decision Making
area_chair.desc: We summarize all the feedback from the simulated peer review and formulate a clear action plan: what needs to be fixed, added, or rephrased to make your paper flawless.

writer.title: Academic Writing & Personalization
writer.desc: Your manuscript undergoes professional rewriting to meet the highest standards of academic medical English, while preserving your personal voice as a researcher.

execution.title: Implementing Corrections
execution.desc: The system applies all the improvements directly into your document. Every change is clearly marked (Track Changes) so you can review what was altered and approve or reject each edit.

qa.title: Final Quality Control
qa.desc: A final, rigorous scan ensures consistency in medical terminology, checks that all links and figure references are intact, and guarantees there are no hidden grammatical errors.

verification.title: Journal Formatting & Cover Letter
verification.desc: We ensure your manuscript meets all the technical requirements of your target journal and draft a formal, persuasive Cover Letter highlighting your study's clinical significance.

compile.title: Compilation & Restoration
compile.desc: After all edits are made, the system packages your manuscript back into a final, clean file, carefully preserving all your original citations (e.g., Mendeley) and page layouts.

export.title: Download for Review
export.desc: The scientific editing process is complete! You can now download your full submission package for self-review before final submission.

submission.title: Automated Journal Submission
submission.desc: The system takes over the tedious technical submission process. Using smart bots, we automatically fill in all manuscript and author details directly into the journal's portal.

peer_review.title: Peer Review Revisions (Ping-Pong)
peer_review.desc: Received 'Revise & Resubmit' feedback? The system analyzes the reviewers' comments, revises your manuscript accordingly, and drafts a respectful, evidence-based Rebuttal Letter for every point.

cascade.title: Journal Cascade Strategy
cascade.desc: If rejected, the journey doesn't stop. The system immediately reformats your manuscript to meet the guidelines of the next target journal on your list and resubmits it to save you valuable time.

dissemination.title: Publication & Dissemination
dissemination.desc: Once published, the system helps you create clear abstracts and summaries for conferences and social posts, maximizing your research's visibility to the medical community.

security.title: Journal Connection Security Briefing
security.whyCredentials: Why do we need your credentials?
security.whyCredentialsDesc: To submit your paper automatically, our system needs to authenticate with the journal's platform (like WordPress or OJS) on your behalf.
security.encryption: Credentials are encrypted using military-grade AES-256-GCM encryption before being saved.
security.neverPlaintext: We never store your passwords in plain text.
security.deleteAnytime: You can delete your connection at any time.
security.consent: I understand and agree to securely store my credentials.
